authentication: No signup is required; proposed requests identify TWIRX through the documented polite-pool contact parameter.
attribution: Preserve DOI, depositor or publisher provenance, source update fields, licenses, funders and contributor roles.
retention: Retain bounded metadata; exclude abstracts and full text until copyright and source policy are explicitly resolved.
personal_data_treatment: Store publisher-deposited public contributor metadata only under reviewed policy; do not enrich personal profiles.
license_notes: Crossref states most metadata is reusable but warns that some abstracts may carry publisher or author copyright.
emergency_disable: No network work order or cursor scheduler exists; future polite-pool jobs remain source-revocable.
initial_scope: Proposed recent and topic-relevant works with selected fields and origin-bounded cursor pagination.
